content.name: Sneha Reddy
content.title: Senior HR Generalist
content.summary: HR generalist with eight years in pharmaceutical manufacturing and IT services, and an MBA in HR. Handles employee relations, statutory compliance and engagement for 2,300 employees at a software services firm, and reduced 12-month attrition from 27% to 18%.

experience.title: Senior HR Generalist
bullets: Act as HR partner for 2,300 engineers and support staff across two delivery centres.
Brought 12-month attrition down from 27% to 18% with skip-level connects and a clearer internal job-posting policy.
Serve on the Internal Committee under the POSH Act and handled nine complaints to closure within statutory timelines.
Coordinate PF, ESIC and gratuity compliance with the payroll team and support audits.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Ran onboarding for about 60 freshers a month, including background verification and induction.
Moved leave and attendance from spreadsheets to Keka HRMS for 900 employees.
Organised quarterly town halls and a rewards programme that raised engagement survey scores by 11 points.

experience.title: HR Executive
bullets: Maintained personnel files and statutory registers for a plant with 750 workers and contract labour.
Coordinated canteen, transport and safety committee meetings with the plant head.
Tracked contractor compliance under the Contract Labour Act for 14 vendors.

achievements.title: Attrition 27% to 18%
achievements.detail: Retention actions at Deccan Code Labs over 18 months.

achievements.title: HRMS migration
achievements.detail: Moved 900 employees to Keka without payroll errors.

interests: Volunteering with a girls' education NGO
